name: Well
description: Well (plan g-deti-naves-grafika, 1×1): +1 for houses nearby; later water for baking and fire-fighting.

variants.name: Stone well with roof
variants.notes: Fieldstone well with a little shingle roof, windlass and bucket.

variants.name: Sweep well
variants.notes: A wooden well with a long counterweighted sweep pole.

variants.name: Stone well with shingle roof 0° (front-right)
variants.notes: Owner's render (14 Nov 2026): round ashlar well on a stone step with a shingle roof, windlass and bucket. The dirt patch under it is cut away so it sits on the terrain or paving. v2: the cut repaired (v1 lost stone joints and left a ragged rim). View 0° (front-right), cut out of the owner's render and scaled to 0.12 wide and 0.106 high (the render's view is a little steeper than the game's). Front corner of the plinth set by hand; this view is the one the game uses.
